subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress Gateway-originated supervised `update.run` managed handoffs and launchd restarts, or remain scoped only to configured startup/background auto-update applies?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but the choice changes the public meaning of an existing environment kill-switch and may block explicit control-plane update requests from agents or the UI.

options.title: Broaden the kill-switch for Gateway update.run
options.body: Honor `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` before creating a supervised `update.run` handoff from the live Gateway, document the new scope, and validate the macOS launchd path.

options.title: Keep it scoped to background auto-update
options.body: Document that explicit control-plane `update.run` is outside the env kill-switch and track launchd restart reliability under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85246.

options.title: Add a separate explicit update.run disable switch
options.body: Introduce a distinct operator policy for control-plane package updates instead of overloading the existing auto-update variable.

recommendation.title: Broaden the kill-switch for Gateway update.run
recommendation.body: Honor `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` before creating a supervised `update.run` handoff from the live Gateway, document the new scope, and validate the macOS launchd path.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` introduced the kill-switch and has the strongest recent history on the startup updater/docs side of this contract.
